text_block_list.text: One day in the cafeteria. In a corner—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —You. Why dost thou inquire of such?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Eep... N-No, well...! I wish to convey 
your allure to our readers... So, 'why do 
you run?'—if you would be so kind as to 
share...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Foolish question. Do not presume to 
measure We with such mundane inquiries.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls Nearby
text_block_list.text:
—Is that a reporter talking to Orfe-san? 
—Are they doing an interview...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's an interview for a magazine.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It's a feature titled 'An Incomparable 
Horse Girl and Those Who Yearn for Her 
Back.' They've lined me up alongside her 
too. Truly, it makes one straighten one's 
posture with reverence.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Though the photoshoot wrapped up without a 
hitch... The interview itself doesn't seem 
to be meshing well at all.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —Enough. The mood is ruined.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?! B-But the interview isn't over 
yet...!

Ignoring the reporter's words, Orfèvre sat 
at a distant table and had her entourage 
of horse girls prepare tea.
choice_data_list:
(Looking at her, she has zero intention of 
answering further...)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Guh... No choice then. I'll structure the 
individual interview centered around Lucky 
Lilac-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—And so, becoming a leading flower of the 
racing world is my goal.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see, truly captivating! But—for example, 
when the one you admire is so exceedingly 
great, do you never feel the frustration 
of falling short?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I won't say not at all. However, I believe 
that only by enduring that can one truly 
bloom into a leading star.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Is that truly so? Surely there are times 
you want to lash out at others or the 
situation? The readers are eager to see 
the 'unfiltered truth'!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well... How should I properly answer 
that...?

Lucky Lilac was clearly perturbed. I 
should probably step in and stop the 
reporter.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —Irksome.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Reporter. Hold thy tongue at once.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: O-Orfe-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hiiik...?! E-Eh? Um, well...!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Offensive. —Know thy place.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: PLEASE FORGIVE MY DISRESPECT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: ...Insufficient.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Thou hast defiled Our presence. Therefore, 
offer thy apologies to all present.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
L-Lucky Lilac-san!! For asking such an 
exceedingly rude question, I am truly, 
deeply sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I-I am quite alright. Truly, please pay it 
no mind...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A-And Trainer-san over there as well!! For 
causing such a commotion, I sincerely 
apologize for the immense disturbance!!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Orfe-san...

Afterward, the interview resumed smoothly 
and concluded without further issue.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Orfe. That's the magazine from the 
interview the other day, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "A role model—you ask? Yes, I have one.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That person possesses not only grace, but 
a sublime nobility that corrects 
everything around her by mere presence 
alone...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I strive daily—so that I might one day 
become like her."

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Endeavor as best thou canst.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san... Allow me to thank you once 
more. Having you stand up for me back then 
gave me such immense reassurance.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Hmph... I require no thanks.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
I merely brushed away some insignificant 
dust.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Ugh. She really is just way too 
cool...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, she's got the kind of back I 
wanna chase forever.
